desc: Take to the field with a perfectly balanced pump that offers instinctive pointability and absolute reliability - the new Field model of the Super X Pump shotgun. Stocked in traditional hardwood and sporting a vent rib barrel with 3" chamber and Invector-Plus™ choke tubes, the Field is ready to drop a limit of birds at your command. Get behind a new Super X Pump Field and you'll be getting ahead of the game.
